title: Identification of transportation network company drivers and transportation network company vehicles.
bodyText: During a prearranged ride, a transportation network company's digital network shall display a picture of the transportation network company driver and the license plate number of the transportation network company vehicle.
bodyHtml: [§279J-6]  Identification of transportation network company drivers and transportation network company vehicles.  During a prearranged ride, a transportation network company's digital network shall display a picture of the transportation network company driver and the license plate number of the transportation network company vehicle. [L 2022, c 57, pt of §2]
